#CSE455 staff — Timesheet

Shared timesheet for CSE455 staff.

* We only record relevant TA commitments.
* No teaching commitments before 09:00 or after 17:00 (hard limit).
* Track a commitment only for the person or group it belongs to. Don't track commitments meant for the larger teaching team.
* No duplicate commitments: if the same thing is already scheduled, don't schedule it again.

*Please add your commitments, each as a new line starting with an asterisk in the format `d.m hh:mm-hh:mm with name`. #CSE455-staff Please make sure to add **all** of your commitments.*

*If you have a commitment that is relevant for the larger teaching team, add a distinct entry that starts with the week number (e.g. `W10 ...`). This can be done after the phrase "*Please add..."*

*To cancel an entry: delete the lines that start with `*`.*

*The timesheet is a `horizontal line` separated list of sections and the next section starts at the next `---`. Make sure to add all of your commitments to the correct section related to your commit/entry. Do not add commitments from week 11 to week 10 etc.*

*Make sure to pay attention to the week currently being evaluated and to your unique contributions. This is week 11.*
